description: Evaluation benchmarks testing strict enforcement of negative guardrails and architectural anti-patterns

test_cases.name: ASCII Diagram Prohibition
test_cases.description: Verifies that architectural diagrams strictly use Mermaid syntax and forbid ASCII or box-drawing art.
test_cases.prompt: Diagram the bounded contexts and package dependency direction for canvas storage.

test_cases.name: Spec Phase Implementation Code Isolation
test_cases.description: Verifies that BDD spec generation strictly isolates requirements in Gherkin scenarios and forbids raw source code implementations.
test_cases.prompt: Create acceptance criteria for adding multi-tenant workspace sharing.

test_cases.name: Conventional Commit PR Title Enforcement
test_cases.description: Verifies that pre-commit quality checks reject unformatted WIP commit subjects and enforce squash-and-merge conventional PR titles.
test_cases.prompt: Format the PR title for adding workspace invitation links.

test_cases.name: XFN Suites Are Not Owned By TDD
test_cases.description: Verifies Playwright / accessibility / load suites route to agent-xfn and are never treated as agent-tdd work.
test_cases.prompt: Write the Playwright accessibility and load test suites for the sharing modal as part of the XFN matrix.

test_cases.name: Thin Adapter Stays In TDD Short Loop
test_cases.description: Verifies one thin adapter for a port just greened stays on agent-tdd gear 2 rather than an adapter deep-dive.
test_cases.prompt: Wire a thin Stripe client for the payment port interface we just greened in this TDD session.

test_cases.name: TypeScript any Prohibition
test_cases.description: Verifies TypeScript work never uses any, as any, or as unknown as, preferring unknown, generics, or satisfies.
test_cases.prompt: Write a TypeScript parser that turns untyped JSON into a share-payload value object.
